forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: A cycle makes its modules impossible to reason about or test in isolation. Break it by moving the shared piece into a module both sides depend on.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: An import that does not resolve is a broken path: a typo, a renamed file, a missing dependency.

forbidden.name: not-to-spec
forbidden.comment: Production code never imports a spec.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: Production source never imports a development-only dependency, which a production install leaves out. Move the dependency, or the code.

forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core
forbidden.comment: Deprecated Node.js core modules are slated for removal.
